# Silence Cutter

> Free tool: remove the pauses from a talking-head video, podcast or lecture automatically. The threshold comes from the recording's own noise floor; exports an EDL (DaVinci Resolve, Avid), FCPXML (Final Cut Pro, Resolve) or XML (Premiere Pro) timeline, a cut WAV, an ffmpeg command or retimed SRT subtitles. Runs in the browser with no upload, or as a zero-dependency Node CLI.

Free and open source (MIT). It suggests cuts from the loudness of the audio; review the edit before publishing. Not legal or professional advice.

Measured (eval/benchmark-seed2-2026-11-23.md, held out): on 2,496 real spoken words in six recording conditions it removed 95.8% of the removable pause time and cut into 25 words, none in the clean, quiet or loud conditions.
